free_tier.stated: Free VPS, web hosting, mirror and AArch64 compute for about 250 open source projects including GNOME, Armbian, Debian and FSFE. Applications were suspended in September 2022 and the service reached end of life in December 2022.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
limits_note: The provider no longer exists, so nothing binds; the failure mode was organisational, with the chief executive unreachable and co-location unpaid.
binding_note: The provider no longer exists, so nothing binds; the failure mode was organisational, with the chief executive unreachable and co-location unpaid.

evidence.proved: report dated 2022-12-04 of the shutdown, the unreachable chief executive, and users told to back up and migrate
volunteer statement that co-location costs could not be paid because only the chief executive had bank access, so servers would go offline
the organisation's own post dated 2022-09-07 announcing that applications were suspended

notes: The generalisable lesson is the failure mode, not the provider: a free VPS programme run by a volunteer nonprofit with one person holding the bank account died within months, and about 250 projects had to migrate. That is the reliability note to attach to any nonprofit free-compute offer, including the ones still running.
